title: Painting in Jahra: coordinated diwaniya and living-room colours with Almusaileem
titleAr: صباغ الجهراء: جدّد الديوانية والصالة بألوان متناسقة مع المسيليم
description: To renovate the diwaniya or lounge? Let’s start with a plan that brings the spaces you see together, and explains what has become of each space.

strings.صباغ الجهراء: جدّد الديوانية والصالة بأل: Painting in Jahra: coordinated diwaniya and living-room colours with Almusaileem
strings.لتجديد الديوانية أو الصالة؟ خلّ البداية: To renovate the diwaniya or lounge? Let’s start with a plan that brings the spaces you see together, and explains what has become of each space.
strings.تستقبل طلبات الأصباغ في الجهراء، وتقدم ت: Receive paint orders in Jahra, supply materials with implementation after reviewing the condition of the walls and required. Send pictures of the place and sizes, and we review with you the scope of work and the need for a preview before adopting the offer.
strings.تصوّر تصميمي لدهان داخلي عاجي مع جدار بل: My design concept for an ivory interior paint with a clay-colored wall
strings.تصميم توضيحي مولّد بالذكاء الاصطناعي، ول: AI-generated illustration, not a photograph of a completed Almusaileem project.
strings.تجديد مكان الاستقبال فرصة ترتّب فيها شكل: Renovation of the reception area is an opportunity to arrange the shape of the house as a whole: the color of the diwaniya, the wall opposite it, and the corridor leading to the lounge. It is not a condition that chooses the same color for everyone, but it is important to determine the relationship between them before implementation, especially if the doors of the rooms are open and the colors appear from more than one angle.
strings.ابدأ من المشهد اللي تشوفه عند الدخول: Start from the scene you see when you enter.
strings.وقف عند المدخل وصوّر اتجاه الديوانية وال: Stand at the entrance and photograph the views towards the diwaniya, living room and corridor. Identify retained items such as flooring, curtains, sofas and doors and use them to guide colour selection. If you want an accent wall, choose it early to avoid unintentionally spreading strong colours across several areas.
strings.عند مناقشة أصباغ الجهراء لمشروعك، وضّح ه: When discussing your project’s paints, explain whether your goal is to unify the open spaces or give Diwaniya a different feel. Images help to understand the idea, but color adoption is specific in place, because lighting and surroundings change how it appears.
strings.بدل عبارة «صبغ الديوانية والصالة كامل»،: Instead of the phrase “Draw Diwaniya and lounge full”, write a short list linking each space to the required work. This step helps you to review the offer and reduce the difference in understanding work time:
strings.الجدران المطلوبة، السقف، الجدار المميز،: Required walls, ceiling, distinctive wall, and paint borders around doors and windows.
strings.اللون الأساسي، المساحات خلف الأثاث، وأي: Basic color, spaces behind furniture, and any parts with a wallpaper or different finish.
strings.بداية اللون ونهايته عند الزوايا والفتحات: The beginning and end of the color at the corners and openings, and whether the color of the lounge continues in it.
strings.الأبواب والكرانيش وإزالة الورق تُذكر كبن: Doors, cranes and paper removals are remembered as separate items, and what you assume are automatically included.
strings.التجهيز يختلف من جدار للثاني: Processing varies from wall to second.
strings.جدار فيه ثقوب قد يحتاج معالجة موضعية، بي: A wall with holes may need to be treated topically, while flakes or weak layers need to be evaluated more extensively before painting. If moisture is affected, the cause should be determined and treatment should be reviewed before painting. Agree on the scope of wall putty, leveling, foundation system and paint according to examination and product, see details
strings.خدمة الأصباغ الداخلية والخارجية لدى المس: Interior and Exterior Paints Service at Almusaileem
strings.اعتمد اللون واللمعة كاختيار واحد: Adopted color and gloss as one choice
strings.جرّب العينة قرب الأرضية والكنب، وشوفها ب: Try the sample near the floor and sofa, and see it in the day and with evening lighting. If the lounge and corridor are connected, check the two samples from one point before installing the resolution. Discuss the sheen level according to the use of the place and the need for cleaning; the name of the color alone will determine the shape of the final finishing.
strings.احتفظ باسم المنتج ورقم اللون واللمعة ضمن: Keep the product name, color number and luster in the agreement. These details are useful when reviewing implementation or planning for a subsequent renewal, and you abandon your order specifically instead of relying on a mobile-only image.
strings.رتّب التنفيذ وراجع العرض قبل البدء: Arrange execution and review the offer before starting
strings.وضّح إذا الديوانية مستخدمة يوميًا، واتفق: Explain if Diwaniya is used daily, and agree on the arrangement of spaces and protection of floors and furniture and who moves heavy pieces. Check the separation between the stages of application and ventilation according to the product instructions, and leave the use of the place linked to the status of implementation and requirements for paint.
